implementation_summary: Fixed all replay attack vectors in CrossChainBridge: (1) Added EIP-712 domain separator with chain ID, contract address, name, and version. (2) Implemented per-sender nonce tracking (senderNonces mapping) to prevent same-chain replay. (3) Updated processTransfer to include sender parameter and validate nonce. (4) Construct EIP-712 typed data hash with TRANSFER_TYPEHASH including recipient, amount, nonce, and sender. (5) Fixed verifySignature to check for zero-address return from ecrecover. (6) Added getSenderNonce helper function for frontend integration. (7) Created comprehensive test suite with 12 test cases covering cross-chain replay, same-chain replay, post-upgrade replay, invalid signatures, nonce validation, and EIP-712 verification.
